summary: Product marketing and AI workflow experience grounded in customer-facing sales and team leadership. Builds useful systems, turns product information into seller resources, and checks AI outputs against source material.

Built an ongoing AI-powered sales-call analysis system; analyzed an initial 65 Gong transcripts and delivered messaging findings and training recommendations to sales enablement.
Checked selected analysis responses through a second AI with the source database, transcript quotation checks, and questions the evidence could not support.
Designed the framework and wrote all content for a live internal catalog of 13 product features; rewrote and restructured a live dealer/seller enablement page.
Authored discovery, objection-handling, pricing, data-sheet, and competitive sales resources.

roles.title: Shift Lead

Helped double department audio attach and increase TV main-unit average selling price from $600 to $750 in one quarter through discovery-focused coaching.

roles.title: Sales Advisor
